'''Tookas''', also known as '''Adoris Felines''', were small [[Feline/Legends|feline]] creatures were native to [[Adoris]]. They were widespread across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], including on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|lower levels]], where vermin infestations made alley tooka populations thrive.<ref name="SWE" />

Tookas were beloved by many [[Species/Legends|species]], who domesticated and kept them as pets, but they were also seen as a plague on many [[Planet/Legends|planets]]. The felines were common companions of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] and [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] captains during space voyages due to their efficacy at controlling pests and killing vermin aboard their [[Starship/Legends|starships]].<ref name="SWE" />

The creatures were so commonplace that they were the inspiration for [[Tooka doll/Legends|stuffed dolls]] and artwork.<ref name="SWE" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Cats in ''Star Wars'', why not?|[[Dave Filoni]]|<ref name="Explore: To Catch a Jedi" />}}
The "Adoris Feline" first appeared in the [[1989]] roleplaying-game adventure [[Otherspace (adventure)|''Otherspace'']]. The [[Encyclopedia (StarWars.com)|StarWars.com Encyclopedia]] entry for tookas clarified that the Adoris feline was the same as the tooka.

Tookas were named after [[Dave Filoni]]'s deceased cat Tuuk. They first appeared as a stuffed doll in the episode "[[Innocents of Ryloth]]," but "[[To Catch a Jedi]]" marks their first appearance in flesh.<ref name="Explore: To Catch a Jedi">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/to-catch-a-jedi-episode-guide|text="To Catch a Jedi" Episode Guide &#124; The Clone Wars}}</ref>

The Episode Guide Trivia Gallery at [[StarWars.com]] detailed more on tookas, with a slide header named "I Can Has Nuna?", referencing the Internet [[Wikipedia:Lolcat|lolcat]] [[Wikipedia:Internet meme|meme]] and weblog "[[Wikipedia:I Can Has Cheezburger?|I Can Has Cheezburger?]]".
